meta.description.en: GLM-5.2 is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model from Zhipu AI with 753B total parameters, targeting complex systems engineering and long-horizon agentic tasks. It supports MTP speculative decoding with up to 5 speculative tokens, async scheduling, and PD disaggregation on Ascend NPUs.

env_setup.container.A3.content.en:
You can use the official Docker image for GLM-5.2 models.

**Docker Pull:**

```bash
docker pull quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.23.0rc1-a3
```

**Docker Run:**

```bash

export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.23.0rc1-a3

docker run \
    --name vllm-ascend-env \
    --shm-size=128g \
    --net=host \
    --privileged=true \
    --device /dev/davinci0 \
    --device /dev/davinci1 \
    --device /dev/davinci2 \
    --device /dev/davinci3 \
    --device /dev/davinci4 \
    --device /dev/davinci5 \
    --device /dev/davinci6 \
    --device /dev/davinci7 \
    --device /dev/davinci8 \
    --device /dev/davinci9 \
    --device /dev/davinci10 \
    --device /dev/davinci11 \
    --device /dev/davinci12 \
    --device /dev/davinci13 \
    --device /dev/davinci14 \
    --device /dev/davinci15 \
    --device /dev/davinci_manager \
    --device /dev/devmm_svm \
    --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
    -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
    -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
    -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
    -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
    -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
    -v /home:/home \
    -v /data:/data \
    -v /tmp:/tmp \
    -v /mnt:/mnt \
    -v /usr/share/zoneinfo/Asia/Shanghai:/etc/localtime \
    -v /root:/host_root \
    -it -d $IMAGE bash
```

> **Note**: A3 has 8 NPUs with dual-die design (16 chips total: `/dev/davinci[0-15]`).

env_setup.pip.content.en:
If you prefer not to use the Docker image, you can build from source. Install vLLM from source first:

1. Clone and install vLLM:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm.git
   cd vllm
   pip install -e .
   ```

2. Clone and install the vLLM-Ascend repository:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend.git
   cd vllm-ascend
   pip install -e .
   ```

**Installation Verification:**

```bash
pip show vllm vllm-ascend
```

Expected result: The version information for both packages is displayed, confirming a successful installation.

> **Note**: If deploying a multi-node environment, set up the environment on each node.

For more details, please refer to the [Installation Guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/installation.html).

verification.en:
After the service is started, the model can be invoked by sending a prompt.

**Completions API:**

```shell
curl http://localhost:<port>/v1/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
        "model": "glm-52",
        "prompt": "Give me a short introduction to large language models.",
        "max_tokens": 256,
        "temperature": 0
    }'
```

> - **URL**: Replace `localhost` with your server IP and use the port from the `vllm serve` command.
> - **`model`**: Must match the `--served-model-name` value from the `vllm serve` command (e.g., `glm-52`).

**Function Calling:**

To enable function calling, add the following flags to the `vllm serve` command:

```bash
--tool-call-parser glm47 --reasoning-parser glm45 --enable-auto-tool-choice
```

Expected result: HTTP 200 with a JSON response containing the `choices` field with generated text.

### Tuning Guidelines

Please refer to the [Public Performance Tuning Documentation](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/developer_guide/performance_and_debug/optimization_and_tuning.html) for tuning methods.
Please refer to the [Feature Guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/user_guide/support_matrix/feature_matrix.html) for detailed feature descriptions.

**Key tuning notes for GLM-5.2:**

|Parameter|Low Latency|High Throughput|Long Context|Description|
|---------|-----------|---------------|------------|-----------|
|`--max-num-batched-tokens`|Lower (4096-8192)|Higher on prefill (8192)|Higher on prefill (16384)|Controls per-step batch size. Lower values reduce per-step latency; higher values improve prefill throughput.|
|`--gpu-memory-utilization`|0.92-0.95|0.90-0.95|0.75-0.93|NPU memory ratio. The 1M scenario must reserve memory for a huge KV cache, so prefill/co-located nodes use lower values (0.75-0.80).|
|`num_speculative_tokens` (MTP)|3-5|3-5|1 (prefill) / 3 (decode)|MTP speculative token count. Higher values improve decode throughput at the cost of draft-model KV cache memory; PD prefill nodes use 1.|
|`enable_dsa_cp`|Optional|Enabled (prefill nodes)|Enabled (prefill nodes)|DSA context parallelism accelerates long-context prefill and has been decoupled from FlashComm1 since v0.21.0.|
|`enable_sparse_sfa_c8` / `enable_sparse_li_c8`|false / true|true / true (PD)|false / true|`enable_sparse_sfa_c8` is an experimental SFA optimization for C8 quantized models; do not combine it with DCP in v0.23.0. `enable_sparse_li_c8` is independent and still recommended.|
|`enable_balance_scheduling`|Enabled (single-node)|Enabled|Disabled for PD|Improves output throughput and lowers TPOT in the v1 scheduler. TTFT may regress in some scenarios; it is not recommended for prefill-decode disaggregation.|
|`VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1`|1|1 (prefill nodes)|1 (prefill nodes)|Communication optimization. Conflicts with `layer_sharding` that includes `o_proj`.|
|`VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLAPO`|-|1 (A2 P/D nodes)|-|Fused operator that can significantly improve performance while consuming more NPU memory; on A3 it is used only on decode nodes.|
|`cudagraph_mode`|FULL_DECODE_ONLY|FULL_DECODE_ONLY (decode)|FULL_DECODE_ONLY (decode)|Captures only the decode phase. PD prefill nodes use `--enforce-eager` instead.|
tuning.zh:
### 调优指南

请参考 [公开性能调优文档](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/zh-cn/latest/developer_guide/performance_and_debug/optimization_and_tuning.html) 了解调优方法。
请参考 [功能指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/support_matrix/feature_matrix.html) 了解详细功能描述。

**GLM-5.2 关键调优说明：**

|参数|低延迟|高吞吐|长上下文|说明|
|----|------|------|--------|----|
|`--max-num-batched-tokens`|较低（4096-8192）|预填充较高（8192）|预填充较高（16384）|控制每步的批处理大小。较低的值降低每步延迟；较高的值提升预填充吞吐。|
|`--gpu-memory-utilization`|0.92-0.95|0.90-0.95|0.75-0.93|NPU 内存比例。1M 场景必须为巨大 KV cache 预留内存，因此预填充/共置节点使用较低值（0.75-0.80）。|
|`num_speculative_tokens`（MTP）|3-5|3-5|1（预填充）/ 3（解码）|MTP 推测数量。较高的值以草稿模型 KV cache 内存为代价提升解码吞吐；PD 模式下预填充节点使用 1。|
|`enable_dsa_cp`|可选|启用（预填充节点）|启用（预填充节点）|DSA 上下文并行加速长上下文预填充，自 v0.21.0 起与 FlashComm1 解耦。|
|`enable_sparse_sfa_c8` / `enable_sparse_li_c8`|false / true|true / true（PD）|false / true|`enable_sparse_sfa_c8` 是 C8 量化模型的实验性 SFA 优化；v0.23.0 中请勿与 DCP 组合。`enable_sparse_li_c8` 独立且仍推荐启用。|
|`enable_balance_scheduling`|启用（单节点）|启用|PD 模式下禁用|在 v1 调度器中提升输出吞吐并降低 TPOT。部分场景 TTFT 可能劣化；预填充-解码分离时不推荐。|
|`VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1`|1|1（预填充节点）|1（预填充节点）|通信优化。与包含 `o_proj` 的 `layer_sharding` 冲突。|
|`VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLAPO`|-|1（A2 P/D 节点）|-|融合算子，显著提升性能但消耗更多 NPU 内存；A3 上仅用于解码节点。|
|`cudagraph_mode`|FULL_DECODE_ONLY|FULL_DECODE_ONLY（解码）|FULL_DECODE_ONLY（解码）|仅对解码阶段进行图捕获。PD 模式下的预填充节点改用 `--enforce-eager`。|

faq.en:
For common environment, installation, and general parameter issues, please refer to the [Public FAQ](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/faqs.html). This chapter only covers model-specific issues.

**Q: How to enable function calling?**

Add the following flags to the `vllm serve` command:

```bash
--tool-call-parser glm47 --reasoning-parser glm45 --enable-auto-tool-choice
```

**Q: How to optimize for single-node low-latency?**

Use `dp1 tp16` configuration and disable expert parallel.

**Q: How to deploy 200k context window?**

Use co-located 4-node configuration with dp4 tp8 and `--max-model-len 200000`.
